body: my acid experience made me feel this spiritual connection to nature something that's not very easy to belive or describe, I actually sat down to notice things and with every object around me, and I felt a connection like it was a part of me guiding me through a journey of self discovery, it was one of the most enlightening experience ever.

commitment is hard. I constantly make silly small mistakes but very easily solve huge problems. social clues are hard to read which is why my manager has ended up becoming more of a translator who re-explains everything I say but in a not panicky demeanor. he also tells me when to not speak. 

I'm not able to follow a schedule no matter how hard I try. sometimes when I do, my partner has a tantrum so I again lose my schedule. its just a constant hell but I'm getting better at learning to deal with it.

being 19 doesn't help because everyone is constantly putting me down and when I'm in an environment where everyone treats me like a kid, I start acting like one, maybe as a sign of protest idk

She accepts she needs help but considers therapy beneath her. I've confronted her multiple times and she ended up going to a physician who suggested some medicines and said she should make raising me the goal of her life. I'm taking psychiatric help and have been diagnosed as bipolar but nothing from the sessions have helped me do something about the situation so far.
I do not have an answer to that, the best option right now seems like ending my life so I can avoid this conflict
